title: Wallet claims (EUDI Wallet / agent virtual wallet)
description: Verified identity claims issued by services/auth_wallet after a wallet presentation (human wallet or agent virtual wallet, nldt/16-eid-wallet-identity.md). Subject model aligned with the EUDI ARF; agent 'assurance' is an administration-defined scale and is never an eIDAS human Level of Assurance.

sub.description: Pseudonymous human subject id (stable per wallet+RP pair; no name)

loa.description: eIDAS Level of Assurance (human subjects only)

deployingOrg.description: Public administration that deployed the agent and issued its credential

capabilities.description: Recipe/process ids the agent is authorised for (consumesRecipes-aligned, BK-2)
